name: Ker Von Ker
lore: The last shield of a dismantled chapel guard, Ker advances slowly because every step is chosen as ground that must never be surrendered.

abilities.name: Shield Breaker
abilities.text: Passive. Add +1 Grit when fighting an enemy with difficulty 8 or higher.

abilities.name: Hold the Line
abilities.text: Once per round, the first battle or hazard Wound assigned to you is prevented. Weakness: when you roll movement, roll 2 dice and use the lower result.
